# Competitive Analysis — Clinic Network Booking

| Competitor | What they do | Where they are strong | Where they leave room | Source |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Incumbent phone-and-paper scheduling | Reception desks take bookings by phone during working hours | Human judgment on complex cases | No out-of-hours booking; unanswered calls are lost bookings (P-1) | canvas: Competition.Unlike |
| General-purpose calendar booking tools | Self-service slot booking on a practitioner's calendar | Fast setup | No clinic-network role model; no per-Specialist service durations | canvas: Competition.Unlike |

Differentiation (canvas §11): booking completes without a phone call, at any
hour, inside the network's own role model.
